Name: Persona 4 and Persona 4 Golden Music Mod updated for 1.6
Author: mycatoreo
Description:
adds arranged music from persona 4 and persona 4 golden to stardew valley

Songs in this mod are 

Backside of the tv: replacing the upper ambients (sewers and skull cavern)

The Fog: replacing the ice part of the mines 

Heaven: replacing the lava part of the mines

Yukiko Amagi's Castle: replacing the earth part of the mines

Shadow World: replacing the main theme 

Corners of memories: replacing the loading screen

Heartbreak heartbreak: replacing all spring songs

Signs of love: replacing all summer songs

Your affection: replacing all fall songs

Snowflakes: replacing all winter songs

Junes theme: replacing the joja mart ( keep in mind this song will play during the opening cutscene)

the velvet room theme replace mr. qui room in both ginger island and in the casino
